arguments.sql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path, search_type,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN stamp END)
               OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_target
    FROM main.activity_log
)
SELECT session, first_target, COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN search_type <> '' THEN 1 END) AS typed_events,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN search_type <> '' AND (first_target IS NULL OR stamp < first_target) THEN 1 END) AS typed_before
FROM events
GROUP BY session, first_target
ORDER BY session

arguments.sql:
WITH sessions AS (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN stamp END) AS first_target
    FROM main.activity_log
    GROUP BY session
),
counted_events AS (
    SELECT s.session, e.path, e.search_type,
           COUNT(e.search_type) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session) AS event_count
    FROM sessions AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.activity_log AS e
      ON e.session = s.session
     AND e.search_type <> ''
     AND (s.first_target IS NULL OR e.stamp < s.first_target)
)
SELECT DISTINCT session, path, search_type, event_count
FROM counted_events
WHERE event_count = (SELECT MIN(event_count) FROM counted_events)
ORDER BY session, path, search_type
